# Vendored style skills

Copies, unchanged, of two skills from the scipi repository, so that a run does not depend on
the source repository being present at run time. Phase 4's style passes apply them (`harness/skills/roles/paper-style.md`).

| Vendored file | Origin path (relative to the scipi repository) | Copied |
|---|---|---|
| `writing-clearly-and-concisely/SKILL.md` | `skills/writing-clearly-and-concisely/SKILL.md` | 2026-10-26 |
| `writing-clearly-and-concisely/references/elements-of-style.md` | `skills/writing-clearly-and-concisely/references/elements-of-style.md` | 2026-10-26 |
| `humanize-ai-writing/SKILL.md` | `skills/humanize-ai-writing/SKILL.md` | 2026-10-26 |
